name: @prova/circuits
description: Prova compliance circuits (Circom + SnarkJS): range + nullifier + KYC-sig.

scripts.compile: mkdir -p build && circom circuits/transfer.circom --r1cs --wasm --sym -l node_modules -o build
scripts.setup: snarkjs groth16 setup build/transfer.r1cs build/pot12_final.ptau build/transfer_0000.zkey
scripts.contribute: snarkjs zkey contribute build/transfer_0000.zkey build/transfer_final.zkey --name='dev' -v -e='dev entropy'
scripts.vkey: snarkjs zkey export verificationkey build/transfer_final.zkey build/verification_key.json
